Class StructuredTaskSupport

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.linker.StructuredTaskSupport
public final class StructuredTaskSupport extends Object
Closed-world plumbing for Juno's JDK 27 preview StructuredTaskScope subset.
